title: Can You Survive Day Two of the Apocalypse?
logline: Picking up at 5:45 AM inside the mountain fire-lookout cabin with almost zero water left as hundreds of infected pour uphill from the dead city, you must find pure mountain spring water, rescue stranded paramedic Maya at a forestry ranger station, and cross a shattered gorge suspension bridge ahead of the horde.
style: 2D minimalist stick-figure cartoon (strict match to user_style_ref_01..03)
